title: Fixed subalgebras of strict local root rotations
statement: Let $H$ be a strictly henselian local commutative ring (henselian local [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] with separably closed residue field), $h\in H$ and $n>0$ with $n$ a unit in $H$. Put $C=H[t]/(t^n-h)$. Let $\mu_n(H)=\{\zeta\in H^\times:\zeta^n=1\}$, acting on $C$ by the $H$-algebra homomorphisms $\rho_\zeta(t)=\zeta t$. For a subgroup $K\subseteq\mu_n(H)$ define $C^K=\{x\in C:\rho_\zeta(x)=x\text{ for all }\zeta\in K\}$, with the inherited ring and $H$-algebra structure. Write $e=[\mu_n(H):K]$. Then $e>0$, $e\mid n$, and there is an $H$-algebra isomorphism $C^K\cong H[s]/(s^e-h)$. Neither regularity nor a nonzerodivisor assumption on $h$ is required.

source.place: Tag 0EYG, final intermediate-field paragraph; Tag 09EV, cyclic intermediate-root calculation

proof.text: Hensel lift the simple residue roots of X^n-1. All n roots lie in H, have pairwise unit differences, and form a cyclic group of order n. For K of order r, its index e is positive and r*e=n; hence e divides n.

The monic power basis of C is 1,t,...,t^(n-1). A generator zeta of K multiplies t^i by zeta^i. For r not dividing i, zeta^i-1 has nonzero residue and is a unit. Comparison of coefficients shows that the fixed subalgebra has basis 1,t^r,...,t^((e-1)*r).

Evaluation s at t^r is well-defined since (t^r)^e=h and its image is fixed. It maps the monic basis of H[s]/(s^e-h) bijectively onto the displayed invariant basis. Thus it is an H-algebra isomorphism; invert it to obtain the orientation asserted. For n=1, K is trivial and this is the identity on the degree-one root algebra.

proof_origin.note: W2 proves Hensel lifting in a new lemma and assembles the equivalence from an explicit power map. Only the general monic-basis image calculation is left unproved.

theorem strict_local_root_invariants
    (H : Type u) [CommRing H] [IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing H]
    (h : H) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n ∧ IsUnit (n : H))
    (K : Subgroup (rootsOfUnity n H)) :
    0 < K.index ∧ K.index ∣ n ∧
      Nonempty (rootFixedAlgebra H h n K ≃ₐ[H]
        AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ K.index - Polynomial.C h))
